name: Grimsby
doing: looking for something to eat by the trolleys at the Albert Heijn
thought: This is not a croissant. This is a relic of someone’s breakfast, and I am not the one who left it.

feeling.words: A flat stone, sun-warmed, edges worn smooth by time. I sit on it, watching the pigeons. One of them flaps too hard and loses a feather.

place.name: the Albert Heijn
place.words: by the trolleys at the Albert Heijn
